value_stream.name: Propane, LPG Cylinder Exchange & Gas Refill Operations

fields.Participants: Cashier (VS-08), Store Associate, Cage/Stock Associate (VS-07), LP (VS-23 — deposit integrity)

workflows.name: Customer Cylinder Exchange Transaction & POS Workflow (Full-for-Empty)

Automation Opportunity: - Barcode scan-in/out (VS-151); exchange-fee auto-calc; deposit-differential automation
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: empty-cylinder intake-inspected (W5069); deposit differential POS-controlled; cylinder IDs scanned (VS-151)
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-151 (auto-ID), VS-23 (LP), VS-16 (O2C); W5059 (interchange), W5062 (price), W5067 (cage), W5069 (condemnation), W5076 (deposit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Condemned-cylinder risk**: Accepting an unsafe cylinder into the pool; mitigated by intake inspection (W5069)
- **Deposit-leakage risk**: Mis-handled deposit differential/cash; mitigated by POS automation + LP controls (VS-23)
- **Transport-safety risk**: Customer transporting unsafely (enclosed cabin); mitigated by safety briefing
System Touchpoints: - POS/exchange module (VS-08); cylinder-asset scan (VS-151); pricing (W5062); deposit/float (W5076); cage inventory (W5067); O2C (VS-16)

steps.activity: Intake the empty & validate: inspect the customer's empty cylinder (size/condition/brand per interchange policy W5059), scan the cylinder ID (VS-151), and confirm exchange eligibility (not condemned — W5069)
Exchange & charge: swap empty-for-full at the cage, process the exchange fee at POS (price W5062), handle the deposit differential, and capture the full-cylinder ID out / empty-cylinder ID in
Customer handoff & safety: brief the customer on safe transport/storage (no enclosed vehicle cabin, upright, away from heat), issue receipt, and update cage inventory (W5067)

fields.Participants: Logistics (VS-06), Refill Vendor (VS-03), DC Ops (VS-04), Store Ops (VS-07), HSE (VS-24)
fields.Trigger: Empty-cylinder backlog at store/DC; re-qual/expiry due

workflows.name: Cylinder Refill, Re-Valve & Hydrostatic-Test Vendor Coordination & Logistics

Automation Opportunity: - Dispatch/receipt scan reconciliation; re-qual-due auto-flag; vendor performance scorecard (VS-67)
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: vendor DOE-licensed & DTI-BPS-certified (VS-117); DG transport compliant (VS-114); cylinder reconciliation (W5076)
Cross-references: - links to VS-06 (logistics), VS-04 (DC), VS-114 (DG transport), VS-117 (DTI-BPS), VS-115 (metrology); W5058 (vendor), W5060 (lifecycle), W5070 (replenishment), W5076 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **DG-transport risk**: Improper cylinder transport (venting/stacking) → incident; mitigated by DG-transport compliance (VS-114)
- **Vendor-quality risk**: Under-fill or unsafe re-qual; mitigated by metrology (VS-115) + DTI-BPS cert (VS-117)
- **Reconciliation risk**: Lost cylinders in the refill loop; mitigated by scan-in/out reconciliation (VS-151)
System Touchpoints: - Cylinder-asset tracking (VS-151/VS-111); logistics/fleet (VS-06); DC ops (VS-04); DG transport (VS-114); vendor mgmt (VS-03); HSE (VS-24)

steps.activity: Consolidate empties & dispatch to refill vendor: collect empties from store cages, consolidate at DC/transfer point (VS-04/VS-06), and dispatch to the DOE-licensed refill/re-qual vendor (W5058) under DG transport rules (VS-114)
Coordinate refill/re-valve/hydrostatic-test: vendor fills to spec, re-vals/re-quals per schedule (W5060), certifies (DTI-BPS/RA 11592 — VS-117/W5059), and returns full/certified cylinders
Receive & reconcile: receive full cylinders, scan IDs back into the pool (VS-151), reconcile counts/condition against dispatch, and replenish stores (W5070)

fields.Participants: Cage Associate, Store Manager, HSE (VS-24), Receiving (VS-07)
fields.Trigger: Daily cage ops; replenishment receipt; exchange activity

workflows.name: In-Store LPG Cage Daily Operations, Inventory & Cylinder Receiving/Dispatch

Automation Opportunity: - Barcode scan-in/out; capacity vs limit alert; auto-replenishment trigger
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: max-cylinder limit enforced; daily leak inspection (W5073); inventory reconciled (W5076)
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (store ops), VS-05 (inventory), VS-151 (auto-ID), VS-24 (HSE), VS-23 (LP); W5061 (cage), W5065 (exchange), W5070 (replenishment), W5073 (safety), W5076 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-capacity risk**: Exceeding BFP max-cylinder limit; mitigated by capacity control + daily check
- **Inventory-drift risk**: Cage count mismatch → stock-out or shrink; mitigated by scan-in/out + reconciliation (W5076)
- **Unsafe-cage risk**: Leak/damage undetected; mitigated by daily inspection (W5073)
System Touchpoints: - Cage inventory/cylinder-asset (VS-05/VS-151); HSE (VS-24); store ops task mgmt (VS-63); receiving (VS-07); LP (VS-23)

steps.activity: Open & inspect the cage: daily leak/visual inspection (W5073), confirm max-cylinder limit not exceeded (W5061), and verify full/empty segregation & signage
Manage cage inventory: scan cylinders in/out (replenishment receipt W5070, exchange W5065, refill W5068), maintain full/empty counts, and flag replenishment need
Close & secure: end-of-day cage secure/lock, inventory reconciliation, and any incident/exception escalation (links W5073/W5075)

fields.Trigger: Customer brings own cylinder for refill (not exchange)

workflows.name: Customer-Owned-Cylinder Refill Service (Weigh, Fill, Seal, Charge)

Automation Opportunity: - Scale-fill automation with rated-capacity cutoff; per-kg POS auto-charge; calibration scheduling (VS-115)
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: fill by calibrated weight to rated capacity (VS-115); unsafe cylinders condemned (W5069); tariff RA 7394-compliant (VS-118)
Cross-references: - links to VS-115 (metrology), VS-08 (POS), VS-24 (HSE), VS-118 (price integrity); W5062 (tariff), W5069 (condemnation), W5078 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overfill risk**: Filling beyond rated capacity → rupture/explosion; mitigated by calibrated weight fill + rated-capacity control (VS-115)
- **Unsafe-cylinder risk**: Refilling an expired/damaged cylinder; mitigated by intake inspection/condemnation (W5069)
- **Metrology risk**: Scale inaccuracy → under/over-charge, consumer-protection violation; mitigated by calibration (VS-115)
System Touchpoints: - Refill scale (calibrated — VS-115); POS (VS-08); pricing/tariff (W5062); HSE (VS-24); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Intake & inspect the customer cylinder: confirm ownership/condition, check re-qual/expiry & valve safety (condemn if unsafe — W5069), and weigh tare/empty
Fill to spec & certify: fill by calibrated weight (VS-115) to the cylinder's rated capacity (no overfill), seal, and apply fill/date tag
Charge & handoff: charge per-kg (tariff W5062), process at POS (VS-08), brief customer on safe transport, and record the refill (analytics W5078)

fields.Participants: Cage Associate, HSE (VS-24), Logistics (VS-06), Supplier (disposal — VS-73)
fields.Volume: ~small % of pool cylinders condemned per year

workflows.name: Cylinder Leak/Damage Inspection, Condemnation & Out-of-Service Quarantine

Automation Opportunity: - Condemnation status → asset-record lock; quarantine-area inventory tracking; disposal-batch documentation
Controls: - CTL-100 (ensure LPG cylinder safety & deposit accounting.)
- CTL-756: condemned cylinders quarantined & asset-locked; disposal per VS-73/RA 11592; intake inspection enforced
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-73 (disposal), VS-114 (DG), VS-151 (asset); W5060 (lifecycle), W5065 (exchange intake), W5068 (refill intake), W5076 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unsafe-cylinder-in-service risk**: Condemned cylinder re-entering the pool → safety hazard; mitigated by quarantine + asset-record lock
- **Venting risk**: Improper handling of leaking cylinder → ignition; mitigated by venting SOP + quarantine
- **Disposal-compliance risk**: Improper scrap of pressure vessels (DENR); mitigated by certified disposal (VS-73)
System Touchpoints: - Cylinder-asset record (VS-151/VS-05); HSE (VS-24); waste/disposal (VS-73); DG (VS-114); logistics (VS-06)

steps.activity: Inspect for leak/damage: visual (dents/rust/valve/base), leak-test (soap/water or detector), and re-qual/expiry check (W5060) at intake and periodically
Condemn & quarantine: tag out-of-service, move to a designated quarantine area (venting safely), and remove from the active pool (asset record update)
Dispose/recycle: route condemned cylinders to certified scrap/recycling (VS-73) or vendor destruction per RA 11592, and reconcile the asset record (W5060)

fields.Participants: Logistics (VS-06), DC Ops (VS-04), Inventory (VS-05), Store Ops (VS-07)

Automation Opportunity: - Min-max auto-replenishment; rebalancing recommendation; transfer scan-reconciliation
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: replenishment min-max controlled; inter-store transfers reconciled (W5076); DG transport compliant (VS-114)
Cross-references: - links to VS-05 (inventory), VS-02 (replenishment), VS-06 (logistics), VS-04 (DC), VS-151 (asset); W5066 (refill loop), W5067 (cage), W5076 (reconciliation), W5079 (forecast)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stock-out risk**: Replenishment lag → lost exchange/refill sales; mitigated by min-max + forecast (W5079)
- **Imbalance risk**: Full cylinders piled where demand is low, empty where demand is high; mitigated by rebalancing
- **Transfer-reconciliation risk**: Cylinders lost in inter-store transfer; mitigated by scan-in/out (VS-151)
System Touchpoints: - Inventory/replenishment (VS-05/VS-02); logistics/fleet (VS-06); DC ops (VS-04); cylinder-asset (VS-151); analytics/forecast (VS-28)

steps.activity: Forecast & trigger replenishment: from cage stock levels (W5067) and demand forecast (W5079), trigger full-cylinder replenishment to low-stock stores
Replenish via DC/refill loop: route through the refill vendor loop (W5066) and DC (VS-04), dispatch full cylinders to stores, and rebalance empties back
Receive & reconcile: store receives replenishment (W5067), scans IDs in (VS-151), and reconciles inter-store transfers against the asset record (W5076)

fields.Participants: Logistics (VS-06), 3PL (VS-56), Driver, Customer Service (VS-13), Cashier (VS-08), HSE (VS-24)

workflows.name: Customer Cylinder Delivery, Exchange-at-Home & Will-Call Service

Automation Opportunity: - Route optimization (VS-06); mobile POS + cylinder scan; POD/cash automation
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: DG-transport compliant (VS-114); cylinder scan in/out; cash controls (VS-142 pattern)
Cross-references: - links to VS-06/VS-56 (delivery), VS-114 (DG), VS-142 (cash handling), VS-08 (POS), VS-151 (asset); W5065 (exchange), W5069 (intake), W5076 (reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **DG-transport risk**: Improper vehicle loading/venting → incident; mitigated by DG-transport compliance (VS-114)
- **Cash/cylinder-loss risk**: Driver cash/cylinder mishandling (links VS-142 COD pattern); mitigated by scan-reconciliation + cash controls
- **Customer-storage risk**: Unsafe storage at home → incident; mitigated by delivery safety briefing
System Touchpoints: - Last-mile/delivery (VS-06/VS-56); mobile POS (VS-08); cylinder-asset (VS-151); DG transport (VS-114); O2C/cash (VS-16); CRM (VS-13)

steps.activity: Take the order & schedule: capture delivery/exchange-at-home order (online/phone — VS-13), schedule the route, and confirm DG-transport-safe vehicle (VS-114)
Deliver/exchange-at-home: deliver full cylinder, collect the empty (intake inspection W5069), process exchange/payment (mobile POS VS-08), and brief the customer on safe storage
Reconcile & close: scan cylinder IDs in/out (VS-151), confirm POD/cash, and update cage/asset records (W5067/W5076)

fields.Participants: Trade/Key Account (VS-11/VS-107), Logistics (VS-06), O2C (VS-16), HSE (VS-24), Supplier (bulk — VS-03)

workflows.name: LPG Forklift & Bulk-Customer Account, Delivery & Refill Management

Automation Opportunity: - Scheduled bulk-delivery automation; account cylinder-asset reconciliation; account profitability dashboard
Controls: - CTL-756 (ensure controlled execution — Cylinder Exchange & Refill Operations (PA-175.2).)
- CTL-756: bulk account credit-checked (VS-68); site-safety assessed (VS-24); cylinders reconciled (W5076); DG transport compliant (VS-114)
Cross-references: - links to VS-11/VS-107 (B2B accounts), VS-16 (O2C), VS-68 (trade credit), VS-06/VS-56 (delivery), VS-114 (DG); W5060 (asset), W5076 (reconciliation), W5078 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Site-safety risk**: Bulk tank / forklift-cylinder storage unsafe at customer site → incident/liability; mitigated by site safety assessment + safety briefing
- **Credit/AR risk**: Bulk-account non-payment; mitigated by trade-credit controls (VS-68/VS-16)
- **Asset-loss risk**: Account-held cylinders not returned; mitigated by asset reconciliation (W5076)
System Touchpoints: - B2B/trade account (VS-11/VS-107); O2C/AR (VS-16); logistics (VS-06); cylinder-asset (VS-151); DG (VS-114); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Onboard & contract the bulk account: credit/contract setup (VS-11/VS-107), determine bulk-tank vs cylinder-for-forklift model, site-safety assessment, and delivery schedule
Deliver & refill on schedule: recurring bulk/cylinder delivery (VS-06/VS-56), refill/exchange on schedule, and DG-transport + site-handling safety (VS-114/VS-24)
Bill & reconcile: bulk/cylinder billing on credit terms (VS-16 O2C), cylinder-asset reconciliation for the account (W5076), and account profitability analytics
